verdict.rationale: The bizfile page states ahead of time that web User Access will be required for Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026. It also explains that User Access controls who may file online for an entity. That is a published, up-front account prerequisite, but it covers only one filing type and does not spell out the full sequence of account, credential, or identity-proofing steps. Missing for 10: a complete published list of account, login, credential and identity-proofing steps for formation and other filings; specifics of how User Access is established and verified; independent or hands-on confirmation that the stated steps match the actual flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Effective August 1, 2026, web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings.
User Access allows the entity to control who is authorized to submit online filings on behalf of the entity.
